lines: FSD (Field Support Drone) "Cancer"
A support-type combat drone developed to assist the mechanized soldiers of secret service agency "G."
Cancer
It took the name Cancer from the fact that it was a small multi-legged tank, so to speak, with a shape resembling a crab.
Its state-of-the-art combat AI made advanced battle support possible, and it was touted as being able to handle any kind of situationー
But this combat AI was unable to gauge the enemy approaching it incautiously.
Sana
What the heck. You're a brainless robot?
Cancer
From the comparison with its database, the tank surmised the enemy in front of it was a Taimanin.
In that case, it would be dangerous for it to judge the enemy's method of attack from just its appearance.
That was because within its data, there was info about Taimanin that could shoot lightning projectiles capable of penetrating its armorー
Sana
Hehe... what's wrong, you piece of junk? Come at me.
Cancer
It had the Taimanin in its range.
The combat AI aborted its analysis of the uncertainties and reached the decision to initiate annihilation.
*Clunk, clunk... clunk...*
The safeties had been deactivated on its main weaponsーtwo primary 12.7mm heavy machine guns, and a secondary 7.62mm machine gun.
But even in such a perilous situationー
Sana
Well then, let me show my cute little juniors how cool I am!!
Without excitement or fear, the Taimanin gulped down a drink in one hand, then reached for the grip of her sheathed tachi and got ready for battle.
Sana
Liquor Jutsu: Strong Styleー
The TaimaninーKozuki Sana curled her lips and murmured.
Liquor ArtーThat was her Ninja Art.
Her Liquor Jutsu: Strong Style enhanced her sixth sense the drunker she got and also granted her a divine spirit's blessing.
While being drunk, she could see through her enemy's attacks, could detect their weaknesses, and sometimes even displayed strength that transcended human limitsー
It ought to have been called the very height of heresy. It was Kozuki Sana's own unique Ninja Art.
Cancer
*Creeeeeeeeeeak...!!!*
Cancer's entire body groaned.
It rushed forward with a deafening motor sound, its two heavy machine guns scattering countless bullets.
*RATATATATATATATATATATATA*ー!!!
Sana
Hehehー
*Cliiing!!!! Clang!! Clank!!!*
ーA metallic sound echoed through the underground space.
Cancer
Cancer's AI froze due to its inability to make a decision.
The bullets that surely should have been on a course to make a direct hit were being deflected somehowー!?
Sana
Ahaha!! Sorry, rust bucket, but you can't shoot a swordfighter with bullets!!!
Sana let out a guffaw and stepped forward at the same time.
*KAKIIIIIIIIIIIIING!!*
Cancer
ーーーーーー!??!!??
A flash of light erupted as Sana drew and slashed her sword.
A straight line, as if drawn with a ruler, ran across the outer shell of Cancer, which boasted stronger protection than an armored vehicleー
Sana
Ace Katana Style Ultimate Skill: Zankusekki Tachiー
ーIt was also called "Dimension Slash."
It was a peerless Battojutsu that could slice enemies no matter their armor, and even rend space itself.
With her skill as a top-class swordswoman, as well as the bewitching power of her magical sword "Diamond's Keen"...
...and her "Mind's Eye," gained from her Liquor Jutsu: Strong Style, it was an ultimate skill no one could have performed before.
*Pzzzz pzzzz!! Pzzz pzzz pzzzz!!*
*Creak... creeeeeeeeak...!!!*
Cancer
After a moment, leaking electricity started to shine intensely from the slash.
And at the same timeー
Slowly, bit by bit... Cancer, which had been sliced in half all the way to the fabric of the space it occupied, slid apart and fell to the ground.
Cancer
ーーーーーーーー!!?!!??
Sana
Hehe... a lowly robot can't defeat a swordfighter, not in a hundred years♪
Meanwhile, the three of us were running toward the entrance of Yomiharaーーー
Shikanosuke
Uwaaaaaah!? H-Hey, Fuma, did you see that!? Sana-senpai is amazing!!!!
Me
Yeah... that's Liquor Jutsu! I didn't know she was a Liquor Art user!!!
We were shouting in astonishment as we sprinted toward the gate to Yomihara.
Sana-san's swordsmanship had been almost frighteningー
Even from our current position, quite a distance away, we were able to clearly see the multi-legged tank get sliced in two, erupt into a cloud of sparks and smoke, and collapse to the ground.
Hebiko
So Sana-san wasn't just drinking because she likes alcohol.
Me
It seems like she does like drinking it though. Alright! We can't lose either!!
Hebiko
Yup! ...Fuma-chan, she's coming again!!!
*WOOOOOOOOOOSH!!!!*
We could feel a powerful rush of hot air from directly ahead of us.
With both hands enveloped in flames, the female cyborg soldier Hestia was blocking our way.
Hestia
Hold yer darn horses, knuckleheads!! Didn't y'all's teachers say not to run in the hall?!
Me
Luckily we're not at school!! ーShikanosuke! Let's do the thing!!
Shikanosuke
F-Fuma!? D-Do you mean... this!?
On my hand signal, Shikanosuke took out a shuriken and threw it.
Hestia
A shuriken~~~~!!? Something like that ain't gonna hurt me none!!
Hestia ignored the shuriken and charged at us.
Her thick body was modified to resist heat and fire. Apparently she didn't think it necessary to dodge something as insignificant as Shikanosuke's shuriken.
Me
(But that's just what we expected!!!)
Shikanosuke
Aieeeee!! H-Here I go!!ーElectric Jutsu: Spark!!!
*Bzz bzzzーBOOOOOOOOOM!!!!!*
Hestia
Right in front of Hestia, a violent explosionー!!
Shikanosuke
I-I did it!!!
Shikanosuke had aimed his Spark at the shuriken he had thrown.
The shuriken was a custom-made product that I had asked the maintenance department of Gosha to create. It was able to work together with Shikanosuke's Ninja Art.
The design was simple. It was an explosive shuriken that was triggered only by Shikanosuke's static electricity.
Me
Nicely done, Shikanosuke!! ーHebiko, can you jump from here!!?
Hebiko
No problem, Fuma-chan!! Guys, grab on!!!
Shikanosuke and I clung to Hebiko, who had already transformed into an octopus. Andー
Hebiko
ーーーーOctopus Jump!!!
This was the jumping technique that she had used before when we had escaped in Maesaki City.
She leapt from the ground, using her octopus tentacles like a spring...
She jumped over Hestia, who had taken the full brunt of the explosive shuriken's blast, and headed toward the gate of Yomihara.
Me
(Running away is our only choice here!!!)
A Taimanin avoids unnecessary fights.
That was an ironclad rule for a successful mission.
If we were able to escape into Yomihara, the cyborg woman and the UFS soldiers wouldn't be able to come after us easily.
That was also why...
Hestia didn't give up easily either.
Hestia
Hahaha, this commotion's just what the doctor ordered!! The crick in my shoulder's done healed itself!!!
Me
(Ugh!? She's a monster!!)
Hestia leapt out of the blast with ease and came after us in hot pursuit.
The explosive shuriken was supposed to have quite a bit of power when it hit directly, but all it did was put a few cracks in her cyborg body.
She shot flames from her hands and came flying after us with frightening speed, like a jet.
Shikanosuke
Aieeeeeee!! Fuma, she's right behiiiiiind!!
Me
ーHebiko!?
Hebiko
This is as fast as Hebiko can go! Hebiko is jumping with you guys on board, remember?!
Me
Then we have no choice!! Let's fight!!
Shikanosuke & Hebiko
Got it!!!
Me
(...But how!?)
In front of Hebiko and Shikanosuke I put on a composed look and gave the order to change the strategy.
But on the inside I was flustered and shaking.
Me
(How are we going to fight against that monstrous cyborg...!?)
Even Shikanosuke's explosive shuriken, that we had specially prepared for this day, could only make some cracks in her armorー
Hestia
Y'all best be ready!!!!
The flame-wielding brute approached, and at that momentーーー
Hestia
Huh!? What's this now!??
Me
Suddenly countless ivy plants sprouted from the ground.
In the blink of an eye, they extended upwards, tangled around the flying Hestia, and dragged her downー
Hestia
What in tarnation!!?
*CRAAAAAAAAASH!!!!*
Hestia had lost her balance while flying and crashed into the ground, sending up a heavy cloud of dust.
Okay everyone, now!!!
Me
Y-Yeah!!
Me
(That voiceー!??)
Prompted by the somewhat familiar voice, we ran toward the gate to Yomihara.
Yomihara, the Underground Cityー
We had barely survived Hestia's pursuit and somehow made it to this plaza.
It truly had been touch and go.
If those ivy plants hadn't helped us right before we got to the gate...
...we most likely would have been burnt to a crisp by Hestia's flames.
Me
(Those ivy plantsー)
Our savior had joined us on the other side of the gate and was now standing in front of us.
Me
Thank you. So you were the operative who had infiltrated before usーーーShizuru.
Kosaka Shizuru
Like~I~said, it's Kosaka-sensei, alright? Long time no see, Fuma-kun♪
Kosaka Shizuru, an English teacher at Gosha Academy and the "Flower Taimanin," smiled broadly.
